# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Office API — Form API

> A form document has exactly the same structure as a document. The only difference is a new forms entity placed with other paragraph elements – text runs, inline text content controls and hyperlinks. There are seven form types: text field, combo box, dropdown list, checkbox, radio button, picture form, and complex field.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. This file covers one part of the [section index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/llms.txt); for the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Form API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api.md): A form document has exactly the same structure as a document. The only difference is a new forms entity placed with other paragraph elements – text runs, inline text content controls and hyperlinks. There are seven form types: text field, combo box, dropdown list, checkbox, radio button, picture form, and complex field.

## Api

- [Api](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api.md): The main class of the Form API. Use it to create forms: text fields, combo boxes, checkboxes and radio buttons, date fields, picture forms, signature forms, and complex fields.
- [Api.ConvertDocument](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/ConvertDocument.md): Converts a document to Markdown or HTML text.
- [Api.CreateCheckBoxForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/CreateCheckBoxForm.md): Creates a checkbox / radio button with the specified checkbox / radio button properties.
- [Api.CreateComboBoxForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/CreateComboBoxForm.md): Creates a combo box / dropdown list with the specified combo box / dropdown list properties.
- [Api.CreateComplexForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/CreateComplexForm.md): Creates a complex form with the specified complex form properties.
- [Api.CreateDateForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/CreateDateForm.md): Creates a date form with the specified date form properties.
- [Api.CreatePictureForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/CreatePictureForm.md): Creates a picture form with the specified picture form properties.
- [Api.CreateSignatureForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/CreateSignatureForm.md): Creates a signature form with the specified form properties.
- [Api.CreateTextForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/CreateTextForm.md): Creates a text field with the specified text field properties.
- [Api.ReplaceTextSmart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Api/Methods/ReplaceTextSmart.md): Replaces each paragraph (or text in cell) in the select with the corresponding text from an array of strings.

## ApiCheckBoxForm

- [ApiCheckBoxForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm.md): Class representing a document checkbox / radio button.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.Clear](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/Clear.md): Clears the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/Copy.md): Copies the current form (copies with the shape if it exists).
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/Delete.md): Removes a form and its content.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetBackgroundColor.md): Returns the background color of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetBorderColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetBorderColor.md): Returns the border color of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetChoiceName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetChoiceName.md): Returns the choice name of the current radio button.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiCheckBoxForm class.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetFormKey](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetFormKey.md): Returns the current form key.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetFormType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetFormType.md): Returns a type of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetGroupValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetGroupValue.md): Returns the choice name of the currently selected radio button in the group.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal id of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetLabel](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetLabel.md): Returns the label of the current check box.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetLock](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetLock.md): Returns the lock state of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the parent element (a paragraph or an inline content control) that directly contains the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetPlaceholderText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetPlaceholderText.md): Returns the placeholder text from the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetPosInParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetPosInParent.md): Returns the position (index) of the current form within its parent element.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetRadioGroup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetRadioGroup.md): Returns the radio group key if the current checkbox is a radio button.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetRole](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetRole.md): Returns the role of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetTag](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetTag.md): Returns the tag attribute for the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the text from the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetTextPr.md): Returns the text properties from the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetTipText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetTipText.md): Returns the tip text of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetValue.md): Returns the current state of the checkbox form as a boolean value.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.GetWrapperShape](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/GetWrapperShape.md): Returns a shape in which the form is placed to control the position and size of the fixed size form frame.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.IsChecked](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/IsChecked.md): Returns the state of the current checkbox (checked or not).
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.IsFilled](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/IsFilled.md): Checks if the current form is filled.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.IsFixed](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/IsFixed.md): Checks if the current form is fixed size.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.IsRadioButton](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/IsRadioButton.md): Checks if the current checkbox is a radio button.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.IsRequired](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/IsRequired.md): Checks if the current form is required.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.MoveCursorOutside](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/MoveCursorOutside.md): Places a cursor before/after the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetBorderColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetBorderColor.md): Sets the border color to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetChecked](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetChecked.md): Checks the current checkbox.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetChoiceName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetChoiceName.md): Sets the choice name for the current radio button.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetFormKey](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetFormKey.md): Sets a key to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetGroupValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetGroupValue.md): Selects the radio button with the specified choice name in the group.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetLabel](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetLabel.md): Sets the label for the current check box.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetLock](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetLock.md): Sets the lock state of the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetPlaceholderText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetPlaceholderText.md): Sets the placeholder text to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetRadioGroup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetRadioGroup.md): Sets the radio group key to the current radio button.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetRequired](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetRequired.md): Specifies if the current form should be required.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetRole](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetRole.md): Sets the role to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetTag](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetTag.md): Sets the tag attribute to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetTipText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetTipText.md): Sets the tip text to the current form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.SetValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/SetValue.md): Sets the state of the checkbox form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.ToFixed](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/ToFixed.md): Converts the current form to a fixed size form.
- [ApiCheckBoxForm.ToInline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiCheckBoxForm/Methods/ToInline.md): Converts the current form to an inline form.

## ApiComplexForm

- [ApiComplexForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm.md): Class representing a complex field.
- [ApiComplexForm.Add](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/Add.md): Appends the text content of the given form to the end of the current complex form.
- [ApiComplexForm.Clear](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/Clear.md): Clears the current form.
- [ApiComplexForm.ClearContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/ClearContent.md): Clears all content from the current complex form, resetting it to its placeholder state.
- [ApiComplexForm.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/Copy.md): Copies the current form (copies with the shape if it exists).
- [ApiComplexForm.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/Delete.md): Removes a form and its content.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetBackgroundColor.md): Returns the background color of the current form.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetBorderColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetBorderColor.md): Returns the border color of the current form.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiComplexForm class.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetFormKey](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetFormKey.md): Returns the current form key.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetFormType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetFormType.md): Returns a type of the current form.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal id of the current form.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetLock](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetLock.md): Returns the lock state of the current form.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the parent element (a paragraph or an inline content control) that directly contains the current form.
- [ApiComplexForm.GetPlaceholderText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiComplexForm/Methods/GetPlaceholderText.md): Returns the placeholder text from the current form.

- [ApiTextForm.IsFixed](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/IsFixed.md): Checks if the current form is fixed size.
- [ApiTextForm.IsMultiline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/IsMultiline.md): Checks if the current text field is multiline.
- [ApiTextForm.IsRequired](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/IsRequired.md): Checks if the current form is required.
- [ApiTextForm.MoveCursorOutside](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/MoveCursorOutside.md): Places a cursor before/after the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetAllowedSymbols](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetAllowedSymbols.md): Sets the allowed symbols for the current text field.
- [ApiTextForm.SetAutoFit](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetAutoFit.md): Specifies if the text field content should be autofit, i.e. whether the font size adjusts to the size of the fixed size form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetBorderColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetBorderColor.md): Sets the border color to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetCellWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetCellWidth.md): Sets the cell width to the applied comb of characters.
- [ApiTextForm.SetCharactersLimit](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetCharactersLimit.md): Sets a limit to the text field characters.
- [ApiTextForm.SetComb](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetComb.md): Specifies if the text field should be a comb of characters with the same cell width.
- [ApiTextForm.SetFormKey](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetFormKey.md): Sets a key to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetFormat.md): Sets the format for the current text field.
- [ApiTextForm.SetLock](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetLock.md): Sets the lock state of the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetMultiline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetMultiline.md): Specifies if the current text field should be miltiline.
- [ApiTextForm.SetPlaceholderText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetPlaceholderText.md): Sets the placeholder text to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetRequired](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetRequired.md): Specifies if the current form should be required.
- [ApiTextForm.SetRole](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetRole.md): Sets the role to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetTag](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetTag.md): Sets the tag attribute to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetText.md): Sets the text to the current text field.
- [ApiTextForm.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetTipText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetTipText.md): Sets the tip text to the current form.
- [ApiTextForm.SetValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/SetValue.md): Sets the text value of the text form.
- [ApiTextForm.ToFixed](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/ToFixed.md): Converts the current form to a fixed size form.
- [ApiTextForm.ToInline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/ApiTextForm/Methods/ToInline.md): Converts the current form to an inline form.

## Enumeration

- [ApiForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/ApiForm.md): Types of all supported forms.
- [Base64Img](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/Base64Img.md): The Base64 image string.
- [CheckBoxFormPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/CheckBoxFormPr.md): Checkbox / radio button properties.
- [CheckBoxFormPrBase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/CheckBoxFormPrBase.md): Specific checkbox / radio button properties.
- [CheckboxOption](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/CheckboxOption.md): Option for checkbox
- [ChoiceOption](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/ChoiceOption.md): Option for radio groups, dropdowns and combo boxes.
- [ComboBoxFormPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/ComboBoxFormPr.md): Combo box / dropdown list properties.
- [ComboBoxFormPrBase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/ComboBoxFormPrBase.md): Specific combo box / dropdown list properties.
- [DateFormPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/DateFormPr.md): The date form properties.
- [DateFormPrBase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/DateFormPrBase.md): Specific date form properties.
- [FormData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/FormData.md): Form data.
- [FormInsertPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/FormInsertPr.md): Form insertion specific properties.
- [FormPrBase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/FormPrBase.md): Common form properties.
- [FormSpecificType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/FormSpecificType.md): The specific form type.
- [FormType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/FormType.md): Form type.
- [ParagraphLikeContainer](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/ParagraphLikeContainer.md): A paragraph-like container that can directly hold inline-level content (Hyperlink, InlineLvlSdt, etc.).
- [PictureFormPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/PictureFormPr.md): Picture form properties.
- [PictureFormPrBase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/PictureFormPrBase.md): Specific picture form properties.
- [RoleProperties](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/RoleProperties.md): The role properties.
- [ScaleFlag](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/ScaleFlag.md): The condition to scale an image in the picture form.
- [TextFormFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/TextFormFormat.md): The text field format data.
- [TextFormInsertPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/TextFormInsertPr.md): Properties for inserting a text field.
- [TextFormPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/TextFormPr.md): Text field properties.
- [TextFormPrBase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/TextFormPrBase.md): Specific text field properties.
- [mm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/mm.md): 1 millimetre equals 1/10th of a centimetre.
- [percentage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/percentage.md): Value from 0 to 100.
- [twips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/Enumeration/twips.md): Twentieths of a point (equivalent to 1/1440th of an inch).
